name: ExtraDock
tagline: Add separate docks for apps, folders, and widgets across displays.
description:
Create a dock for a display or workflow, attach it to a screen edge, or let it float. Configure positions, sizes, and shortcuts independently. ExtraDock 5 supports macOS 26 and 27. The developer offers ExtraDock 4 for macOS 12 through 15.

## Pricing
Lifetime Access includes one year of updates. Forever Edition includes future updates.
pricingDetails: Lifetime and Forever one-time licenses available
